meaning: Every declared benchmark goal clause has an action path or terminal invariant check; physical success still depends on grounding, reachability and execution.

clauses.terminal_check: TaskEvaluator.on checks support geometry and post-release tilt
clauses.conditions: Ground an available object alternative and a valid support. Use edge placement when the grasp mode requires it.

clauses.terminal_check: TaskEvaluator.near checks pairwise bottom-centre distances on the support
clauses.conditions: Place each selected item within max_dist/2 of one shared hint; then run the pairwise task evaluator. Single-skill hint checks alone do not establish the group predicate.

clauses.terminal_check: TaskEvaluator.closed checks every requested articulated joint
clauses.conditions: Repeat the appropriate close Skill for each measured open joint; already-closed joints need no action.

clauses.terminal_check: TaskEvaluator.not_dropped checks the global initial-to-final scene invariant
clauses.conditions: Prevent drops during each action. If a recoverable item falls, pick and replace it; this global invariant is not guaranteed by one SkillNode.

clauses.terminal_check: TaskEvaluator.inside checks all selected items in one grounded container
clauses.conditions: Select one present container alternative and repeat pick/place for each item; relocate the container first if the task also requires on(support).
